t: RoMagic Exhibition: Proudly Queer Unapologetically Roma - European Roma Rights Centre
s: This exhibition was held in 2025 across Brussels, Bucharest, and Belgrade and was co-created by Romani LGBTQI+ activists in collaboration with non-Romani allies and the ERRC. It was part of the RoMagic project, documenting oppression and resilience of LGBTQI+ Roma, and presents brave personal testimonies through intimate documentary photography and raw audio interviews.
